output.reason: The changelog [ev-180d9754a48a] and PR #11657 [ev-7eec6f8c5062][ev-3cc623c7157a] describe the fix: when the log results cache gets a hit, it now builds the empty response from the current request instead of the cached one. None of them names a CLI flag, config key or values key that turns the log results cache on. The changed files [ev-a9f2952e2323] cover only log_result_cache.go and its test. So the proposed leaf, cli-flag --cache.enable-results-cache set, has no support in the evidence, and it may not even be the switch for this cache. To decide, we need the configuration setting that enables Loki's log results cache in the query frontend.
